title: To Chico With Tomato Joe The Tao of the Flip Quick sip. Equip the dancing Shoes Tapping to Chico Blues #smallpoems #mb #ncte18
summary: To Chico With Tomato Joe The Tao of the Flip Quick sip. Equip the dancing Shoes Tapping to Chico Blues #smallpoems #mb #ncte18
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
To Chico
With
Tomato Joe
The Tao of the Flip
Quick sip.
Equip the dancing
Shoes
Tapping to Chico Blues

#smallpoems #mb #ncte18
